sources.label: Wikipedia, "Zeta2 Lyrae"
sources.quote: Zeta2 Lyrae, also named Urquchillay, is a single, white-hued star in the northern constellation of Lyra.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 2.0 solar radii and 1.63 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,257 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Zeta2 Lyrae"
sources.quote: It is a dim star that is just visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 5.74 An annual parallax shift of 20.6 mas as seen from Earth provides a distance estimate of about 158 light years from the Sun.
